pundit.name: Landon Donovan
pundit.take: **Look, I get why people say England should win today, but when "The Backpass Assassin" drafts Jordan, you're left asking if he understands geography or soccer.** I feel for Gayden, really I do—he means well—but when you're sitting in fourth place partly because you thought Jordan would do anything other than fill a spot, it's like drafting with a map of the Middle East instead of a strategy book. Meanwhile, Devin's "Ghost Pepper" strategy might not be sizzling, but it did earn him a solid 13 points by squeezing a 2-1 victory out of Spain against Belgium. As for Norway facing England today, it's hard to bet against Devin's kind of consistency. So, I confidently (if not wisely) predict Norway will demonstrate that sometimes, erratic picks beat out misguided ones. Bless Gayden's heart, but without an upset miracle, he might want to expand his playbook beyond just passing backwards.
